definitions.usage: exalt, get (oneself) up, lift up (self), mount up.
definitions.full: H7426. ramam I. [ רָמֹם ] verb be exalted (|| form (according to Masora) of רום ); — Qal Perfect 3plural וְאֵינֶנּוּ מְעַט רוֺמּוּ Job 24:24 (perhaps passive form Ges § 67m Bu; Du רֻמוֺ ); — Participle רֹמֵם see רום Po-'1. Niph`al Imperfect 1singular אֵרוֺמָ֔ם Isa 33:10 (|| אֶנָּשֵׂא ; Hithpo`lel from רום Kö i. 454 Ges § 54c ), 3 masculine plural וַיֵּרֹ֫מוּ Ezek 10:15 (of cherubim), יֵרוֺ֫מּוּ 10:17 , וַיֵּרוֺ֫מּוּ 10:19 ; Imperative masculine plural הָעֵדָה מִתּוֺח הֵרֹ֫מוּ Num 17:10 (P). [ רָמַם ] verb denominative be wormy ; — Imperfect 3masculine singular (with accusative result, Ges § 121d N) תּוֺלָעַים וַיָּ֫רֻם Exod 16:20 (Ges § 67n ; + וַיִּבְאַשׁ ). עֶזֶר רֹמַמְתִּי see below רום .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”
They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone.
The right hand of Yahweh is exalted!
The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

The cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
